title: Scalextric Sport / Digital

scope.basis: Core 1:32 Sport/Digital track and borders on 2016 catalogue pages 60–61, checked against available current manufacturer product pages.
excluded: Full Classic track catalogue beyond C8222 adapter
Powerbases, lap counters and newer long-straight / double-curve variants pending a separate expansion
Loose supports, scenery and separately sold guardrail hardware
scope.availability: Historical catalogue inclusion is not a current stock claim.

defaults.evidence: Published nested outer radii 214, 370, 526, 682 mm imply a 156 mm increment. Using that as surface width and half as lane spacing is an explicit model assumption, not independent dimensional verification.

visualStyle.road: Fine charcoal surface, no centre dashes on ordinary track
visualStyle.slots: Paired silver rails around dark slots
visualStyle.borders: Tan shoulders with small red/white kerbs and grey barrier edge
visualStyle.connectors: Illustrative protruding tabs; not manufacturing geometry
visualStyle.basis: Manufacturer catalogue drawings and current straight, border and pit product images inspected

sources.title: Scalextric manufacturer catalogue 2016, pages 60–61
sources.note: Visually inspected. Small radius labels contain a factor-of-ten unit error; larger embedded drawing and 2025 listing give 214/370/526/682 mm.

sources.title: Scalextric manufacturer catalogue 2025, indexed track diagram
sources.note: Search-index text only; download blocked. Used to cross-check radius progression, not visual inspection.
